name: @unum-cloud/uform
description: Pocket-Sized Multimodal AI for Content Understanding and Generation
author: Ash Vardanian, Unum Cloud

scripts.build-js: tsc -p javascript/tsconfig-esm.json && tsc -p javascript/tsconfig-cjs.json && cp javascript/dist-package-esm.json javascript/dist/esm/package.json && cp javascript/dist-package-cjs.json javascript/dist/cjs/package.json
scripts.build-native-stub: cmake-js compile --out build_node_stub --CDUFORM_BUILD_STUB=ON --CDUFORM_BUILD_NODE=ON --target uform_node && node javascript/stage-prebuild.js build_node_stub
scripts.build-wasm: cmake --preset wasm32_emscripten -DUFORM_BUILD_NODE=ON && cmake --build --preset wasm32_emscripten --target uform_wasm && mkdir -p javascript/dist/wasm && cp build_wasm32_emscripten/javascript/uform.mjs build_wasm32_emscripten/javascript/uform.wasm javascript/dist/wasm/
scripts.prebuild: npm run build-native && node javascript/stage-prebuild.js build_node
